fitAnalysis.assessment:
Fair Fit (68%): solid FP&A core, but key tech and SaaS gaps reduce competitiveness.

**Strengths:**
- 5 years FP&A: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis across industries
- Advanced Excel (INDEX/MATCH, VBA) plus Power BI dashboards on SAP data
- ACCA in progress (9/13) adds credibility to financial modeling claims

**Gaps:**
- No Pigment, Tableau, or Metabase experience (required BI tools)
- ROI analysis and board materials preparation not evidenced on CV
- No exposure to SaaS or consumption-based business models

**Recommendation:** Apply now, but highlight your Power BI and forecasting depth in the cover letter, and note any self-taught Tableau or AI tool use to close the visible gaps.

tomas.brandt@example.com

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Rebuilding a forecast model around order backlog lifted accuracy from 88% to 96% for a business unit inside an 85 million USD revenue portfolio. That kind of hands-on model work is exactly what Datadog's R&D Finance team needs as it manages headcount, AI spend, and product investment decisions alongside the company's engineering leadership.

Across five years in FP&A for manufacturing and retail businesses, I have owned rolling forecasts, departmental budgets, and variance reporting in environments where data quality and speed both matter. I built Power BI dashboards on SAP data to give operational leaders clear visibility into performance, and I automated month-end journal checks in Excel VBA to cut close reporting from nine working days to six. That combination of financial modeling depth and a builder mindset translates directly to the cross-functional budgeting and analytics work your team runs across R&D.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my forecasting and financial modeling background can support Datadog's planning cycles. I am available for a conversation at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt

applicationEmail.subject: Application: FP&A Analyst, Tomas Brandt
applicationEmail.body:
Hi there,

With 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting, and variance reporting across manufacturing and retail businesses, I was drawn to the FP&A Analyst role at Datadog and the scope of financial ownership it involves. At Calder Industrial Components, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD, and rebuilt a forecasting model that lifted accuracy from 88% to 96% by anchoring it to order backlog data. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I would welcome a conversation at your convenience and am available any day next week for a call.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
